en: Windows: Fixed Claude Code running a `.cmd` or `.bat` wrapper found beside a program's `.exe` in the same PATH folder (a `git.cmd` next to `git.exe`, say); it now runs the `.exe`, as `cmd.exe` would
zh: Windows：修复了 Claude Code 运行与程序 `.exe` 位于同一 PATH 文件夹旁的 `.cmd` 或 `.bat` 包装脚本的问题（例如 `git.exe` 旁的 `git.cmd`）；现在会像 `cmd.exe` 那样运行 `.exe`
